x: Nicholas Kello · Senior · Trk. C.C. Rd.
He sailed into the scoring ten to prove that there is plenty of life in his legs yet. New members Ray Foley and Nick Kello closed in our team.

Pick of the 'B' runners was City Dealer Nick Kello who'd have gone faster still had he arrived a little earlier and taken the 1st stage. Fastest in our women's team was Laura Wilson, still not quite 16 years of age and seemingly able to tackle any distance from 200m to 3k.

Then came a bunch of Belgravians, Roger Alsop, Nick Kello, Phil Carstairs, and Said Chettati nicely packed in the low twenties. The end of first short lap saw Graham maintaining his position in the leading bunch, Roger moving up, Nick dropping back slightly, and the others roughly the same.
Limping along prior to coming out at half way, Nick Kello had badly twisted an ankle, putting paid to his running activities for a few weeks.

Last minute recruit for a long stage Mike Webb enjoyed his Essex outing, giving way to Old Gaytonians and finally a Friday night recruit Nick Kello celebrated his birthday (and the Team Manager's) by holding steady in 8th.
